summary: Verified A/B/C/D audit fixes for KNHOST ERP. Backend A1 global stock fields and B3 lots filter counts match spec. UI testids for A2 (POS global stock cards), B1 inventory-board, B2 stock-buckets, B3 lots filters, C1 Operasi Gudang hub (?view=operations) tabs & inner wms-tab-*, C2 Barang Masuk tabs + OCR settings link, C3 settings-hub Gudang section + receiving-ocr settings tabs, D1 orders, D2 special-orders, D3 sample-orders all render as expected. Preview-allocation endpoint still functional. One backend gap found: /api/products omits entity_available_qty.

minor.issue: Missing 'entity_available_qty' field in product items (dashboard has it; spec says /api/products should also return it alongside stock_scope/available_qty/incoming_so_qty/incoming_restock_qty). All other required global-stock fields present.

No user with role 'warehouse_admin' exists (test_credentials.md references whadmin@ with password demo1234, but 401; roles in DB only include 'warehouse'). Cannot test C3 'warehouse_admin can open Pengaturan and sees only this tab'.

ui_bugs.issue: On admin@ POS (?view=sales&entity=ent_kanda) BTK-MEGA-001 and LRK-CLSC-001 Terlaris cards show 'Habis' badge even though their main catalog cards show available 310 global. The 'Terlaris' section still appears to use per-entity availability instead of global.

notes_on_spec_vs_actual.A1_BTK_MEGA_001_values: available_qty > entity_available_qty confirmed (test asserted). Exact numbers printed in pytest stdout.
notes_on_spec_vs_actual.B3_lots_counts: all 6 counts match spec exactly (total 34; receiving 1; makloon 10; stage yarn 3; karantina 6; q=BTK 13)
notes_on_spec_vs_actual.orders_pager_D1: orders-pager not rendered — likely because dataset <=20 rows (expected behavior). Spec says 'pagination remains', assumed OK when count exceeds threshold.
notes_on_spec_vs_actual.D1_tabs_shipped_done_cancelled: Only verified orders-status-tab-bar presence. Individual tab testids orders-status-tab-{all,reserved,waiting_stock,confirmed,shipped,done,cancelled} not individually probed.

action_items: Add 'entity_available_qty' field to /api/products response items (mirror dashboard enrichment).
Fix 'Produk Terlaris' curation on POS so Habis badge uses global stock scope (same rule as main catalog grid).
Seed a warehouse_admin role user (e.g. whadmin@kainnusantara.id with demo12345) so C3 role gating can be verified, or clarify intended account.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard and products should share one enrichment function; current drift is why entity_available_qty is missing in /api/products.
POS 'Produk Terlaris' widget likely bypasses the central stock computation path (sales_stock_service.apply_global) — should use the same source.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all key testids present; 1 Habis badge inconsistency)

test_credentials: admin@kainnusantara.id / demo12345 OK; sales@ OK; whadmin@ 401 for both demo12345 and demo1234 (role missing in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_global_stock.py with 10 cases. Login via UI form uses data-testid login-email-input/login-password-input. Operasi Gudang hub view is at ?view=operations (not ?view=wms). Sales user is bound to ent_ksc not ent_kanda — use admin to probe ent_kanda stock.
